About Us 
Established in 1946, Teys Australia is a beef processing and food production business. We are best known for providing quality Aussie beef to customers here in Australia and around the world.  
With operations across 14 locations in Qld, NSW, Victoria, and South Australia, we are the second largest beef processor and exporter in Australia, employing over 5000 passionate people who drive our success, and bring their very best to work every day.  
Together, we focus on feeding people and enriching lives. Join us! 


About the job

We are seeking experienced meat workers (boners, slicers, and slaughtermen) and general entry-level production workers who value coming to work in a safe and supportive environment.

With various areas requiring reliable new team members, depending on your previous experience and skillsets, you could find yourself doing any of the following activities:

Production work/process line
Trimming, cutting, boning, and slicing
Cleaning and sterilising work areas and equipment
Meatpacking
General labouring
Chiller room operations
Operation of equipment and machinery
Distribution and warehousing
Packing
Scanning
Industrial cleaning

Annual range = $59,826 - 80,996 p.a
Hourly range = $30.27 - $40.99

To be successful, you must meet the following requirements:

Australian Citizen/Permanent Residency/Full Working Rights in Australia are essential
Pass a pre-employment medical check, including a drug and alcohol test
Q-Fever vaccinated (or willing to get)
Be able to provide two professional references


What's in it for Your

We can offer you a full-time, secure, and permanent job with proper industry training and supportive management. You will be a valued team member and will work in a fast-paced environment that has a focus on safety and wellbeing.

As a full-time, permanent employee, you will work a minimum of 38-40 hours per week with the potential for overtime and weekend work.

Other Benefits for You

Above award wages
Secure, permanent employment that rarely has down days 
Supportive and caring environment
On-The-Job Training
Paid Inductions
Career Progression
Access to discounts on meat and other products

We are connected socially so check us out at www.teysaust.com.au or join us on (https://www.facebook.com/TeysAustralia/).

Location: Salisbury, QLD, 4107
Full-Time: Immediate start
Job Title: Welder
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About the Role
Our client is a leading steel fabricator specializing in large-scale structural projects bridges, mining infrastructure, and commercial buildings. Precision, quality, and safety are at the core of their workshop operations. We are recruiting an experienced Welder to join their team and deliver high-integrity welds on heavy steel sections to exact engineering specifications.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Interpret detailed engineering drawings, blueprints, and welding specification sheets to determine material grades, joint configurations, and correct welding procedures.
• Select, inspect, and prepare metal stock; cut marked-out structural sections using oxy-fuel torches, plasma cutters, and guillotines to precise dimensions.
• Shape and bend steel beams, channels, and pipes using hydraulic presses, bending rolls, and manual heating/hammering techniques to achieve required profiles.
• Align and fit components using clamps, jigs, and measuring tools; join sections via MIG, TIG, flux-cored arc welding, and bolting/riveting methods.
• Examine completed welds for bead width, penetration depth, and dimensional accuracy; perform visual checks and assist with non-destructive testing.
• Finish products by grinding, filing, polishing, and cleaning weld zones; apply protective coatings or acid baths as per project standards.

Requirements
• Minimum two years’ welding experience in structural steel fabrication; relevant trade certificate (or equivalent) and current welding certifications.
• Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings and welding symbols; thorough knowledge of weld procedures and site safety protocols.
• Capable of welding in all positions on heavy plate and sections; comfortable operating overhead cranes and workshop machinery.
• Relevant qualification to above field.

Apply now 
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience in Welder. Applications will be reviewed as received, therefore, please apply as soon as possible before the closing date.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

 We are seeking a reliable and detail-focused Microbiologist to join a beverage manufacturing environment based in the Swanbank / Ipswich area. This role will support the site's quality and food safety standards through microbiological testing, sampling, analysis and accurate reporting.  This is a great opportunity for someone with strong laboratory discipline, an eye for detail and a genuine interest in quality assurance within food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing.   About the Role  Reporting into the quality or laboratory team, you will be responsible for conducting microbiological analysis across beverage products, water systems and sampling programs. You will play an important role in ensuring products and processes meet required quality, safety and compliance standards.   Key Responsibilities:  
 
 Conduct microbiological testing and analysis on beverage samples. 
 Perform water microbiological analysis in line with site requirements. 
 Complete routine product, water and environmental sampling. 
 Prepare, handle and process samples accurately and safely. 
 Record, interpret and report microbiological results in a timely manner. 
 Maintain high standards of hygiene, laboratory cleanliness and documentation. 
 Support investigation of out-of-specification results or quality concerns. 
 Follow laboratory procedures, quality systems and food safety requirements. 
 Work closely with production and quality teams to support safe and compliant operations. 
 Assist with continuous improvement activities across microbiological testing and sampling processes. 
 
  About You  To be successful in this role, you will bring a strong understanding of microbiological testing principles and a careful, methodical approach to laboratory work.   You will ideally have:  
 
 Qualifications in Microbiology, Food Science, Laboratory Techniques or a related discipline. 
 Previous experience in microbiological analysis, ideally within food, beverage, FMCG, water testing or a manufacturing environment. 
 Experience with beverage, water or environmental sampling will be highly regarded. 
 Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation skills. 
 Understanding of hygiene, food safety and quality requirements. 
 Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. 
 Good communication skills and a proactive attitude. 
 Availability to work day shift, 8:00am to 4:00pm. 
 Flexibility to work across a 5-day roster, including Saturdays and Sundays where required. 
 
  What's on Offer  
 
 Full-time day shift opportunity. 
 Immediate start available. 
 Work within a quality-focused beverage manufacturing environment. 
 Hands-on microbiology and sampling role. 
 Opportunity to contribute to product safety, quality and compliance. 
 Supportive team environment.

Seven Corp on behalf of Tony and Marks Direct  

Overview: 

Tony & Mark's is a proudly family-owned South Australian business that has been providing premium fresh produce, gourmet foods, and exceptional customer service for over 46 years. With multiple retail locations across Adelaide, we are committed to sourcing the highest quality local and international products while supporting growers, suppliers, and the communities we serve. Our team is passionate about delivering an outstanding shopping experience built on quality, freshness, and service excellence.

We are currently seeking a Fruit and Veg Inspector to join the team! you will be responsible for maintaining the quality, safety, and compliance of fresh produce through inspections, food safety monitoring, and quality assurance processes. This is a full-time ongoing position, working 38 hours per week based in Cavan, SA.

Main tasks:

-	Inspect incoming fruit and vegetables for quality, freshness, grade, size, colour, and condition
-	Develop and monitor QC procedures (Freshcare SC2, HACCP, HARPS)
-	Measure and record cold chain temperatures; report deviations
-	Test samples and make accept/reject decisions
-	Ensure hygiene standards in storage, packing, dispatch, and transport
-	Identify and manage non-conforming products; coordinate corrective actions
-	Evaluate supplier performance and escalate non-conformances
-	Maintain inspection logs, temperature records, and non-conformance reports
-	Advise purchasing and warehouse teams on stock condition and availability
-	Conduct internal audits of food safety procedures
-	Liaise with suppliers, transport contractors, and internal stakeholders
-	Stay current with Australian food safety regulations and produce standards

Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum of relevant Diploma, plus minimum 1 year’s relevant work experience in the last 5 years.
-	3 years’ relevant work experience may substitute the formal qualification.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	1 year's experience in fresh produce inspection/QC (wholesale, not retail)
-	Freshcare SC2 knowledge
-	HARPS familiarity
-	Cold chain management experience
-	HACCP knowledge
-	Strong documentation and record-keeping
-	Availability from 3:00 AM
-	Able to work in cold storage (0°C–4°C)


Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.
